item.title: Iran War Updates: Tehran and U.S. Offer Conflicting Messages on State of Negotiations
item.description: President Trump said his administration had had “very good talks” with Tehran in the last 24 hours. An Iranian official said an American plan to end the war was under review. Israel struck targets near Beirut.

item.title: Middle East war live: source close to Hezbollah says top commander killed in Israeli strike
item.description: A senior commander from Hezbollah's elite force was killed in an Israeli strike on Beirut's southern suburbs on Wednesday, the first on the area in nearly a month, a source close to the group said. At least 11 other people were killed in strikes across the south and east, according to the Lebanese health ministry. Meanwhile US President Donald Trump said Wednesday he believed a deal with Iran was 'very possible', but threatened to resume his bombardment of the country if negotiations fell apart

item.title: Draymond Green refuses to let Charles Barkley bury the Warriors, delivers cutting Rockets jab on air
item.description: Draymond Green joined "Inside the NBA" and roasted Charles Barkley's Houston Rockets era after Barkley declared the Warriors dynasty officially over.

item.title: What to know about potential US-Iran agreement
item.description: The one-page memo calls for negotiations over 30 days.

item.title: Israel strikes Beirut suburbs, threatening already shaky ceasefire
item.description: The airstrike on the Haret Hreik neighborhood targeted the leader of the Radwan forces, Hezbollah’s elite and battle-hardened fighting unit, Israeli authorities said.

item.title: Live: Israel strikes Beirut's southern suburbs, Netanyahu says targeted top Hezbollah commander
What Israel wants from an Iran peace deal: No enrichment, missile limits and strict enforcement
item.description: Israel wants Iran to stop enrichment, dismantle underground nuclear sites, restrict missiles and cut ties to Hamas and Hezbollah, experts say.

item.title: Strikes in U.A.E., Oman and at Sea Strain Iran Truce to the Breaking Point
item.description: The drone and missile attacks were the first of their kind since the U.S.-Iranian cease-fire began last month. They coincided with reported clashes between American and Iranian vessels in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: US and UAE report Iran attacks as military pushes to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: US forces opened a passage through the Strait of Hormuz on Monday after sinking Iranian boats and escorting merchant ships, as fresh attacks struck vessels and facilities in the United Arab Emirates. The escalation has raised fears over global energy supplies and risks derailing a fragile regional ceasefire.

item.title: Thirteen killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, health ministry says
item.description: Four women and a child are among the dead, as fighting between Israel and Iran-backed Hezbollah continues despite a ceasefire.
